Green glass, tar-sealed, heavy as sin. He cracked it on the rocks the way his father taught him and unrolled a note gone soft as cloth. The ink had bled, but he could read enough: 'To whoever keeps the light — I saw you every night for two years from the ship, and I never once waved. I wave now.' Thomas sat a long while on the cold stones. Then he climbed the ninety-nine steps, lit the lamp, and stood waving at the empty sea until morning, on the chance anyone was watching.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像退潮后的滩涂，安静得能听见路灯的电流声。环卫工人橙色的身影扫过长街，卷起几片落叶；早点铺的灯先亮了，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白汽，像海面上初升的雾。写字楼还黑着，只有零星几层亮着灯，那是睡不着的人和赶稿的人。出租车空驶过路口，红绿灯为无人的斑马线变换颜色。流浪猫从车底钻出来，抖了抖毛。这座城市在醒来之前，先轻轻地呼吸了一下。", "w03": "- Imagine a line of dominoes: you only knock over the first one.\n- Each domino does the same small job: fall and tap the next one.\n- Recursion is that: a thing does one small step, then hands the rest to another copy of itself, until nothing is left to do."}
